competences.description: Attacks the enemy to inflict damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken.

Grants the counterattack effect for 2 turns and Threat state on the ally target. Enemies excluding the boss can only attack the target under the Threat state with attack skills while enemies attack with a single-target skill 2 times.

effets.description: When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.

The enemy can only attack the target under the Threat state when using the attack skill. The duration of the Threat will be reduced only by skills that attack a single enemy target. The target under the Threat state will be inflicted with 15% less damage when attacked.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects. Afterwards, increases the Attack Bar of the ally with the highest Attack Bar by 25% and the Attack Power of the ally with the second highest Attack Bar for 2 turns.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
The target's Attack Power will be increased by 50%.
